summary: Describes problems that arise when a device is connected to several networks at once and receives configuration from each. Some settings apply to the whole device and others to one interface, so conflicts can cause traffic to use the wrong interface or names to clash. It is a problem statement, not a solution.

eli5.summary: Imagine getting different directions from two friends at the same time. A phone on wifi and mobile data can get mixed-up instructions, and this document lists the troubles that causes.

questions: why does my device pick the wrong network interface
